question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and security institutions underpins trader consensus at 95.3% that he will remain in office through 2026. Ongoing anti-corruption purges have aligned senior political and military figures with continuity, while constitutional changes years earlier removed term-limit constraints ahead of the 21st Party Congress in 2027. No institutional challenges, public health disclosures, or elite fractures have surfaced in recent months to alter this positioning. An abrupt leadership crisis triggered by sudden health developments, major policy reversal, or rapid realignment within the Politburo could still shift outcomes before year-end, though such events lack supporting indicators in current reporting.
